evals.name: invoice-from-timesheet
evals.prompt: Here's the March timesheet export for Acme in acme-march-timesheet.json (project root). Can you turn it into a PDF invoice? Bill each entry's hours at its rate, total in dollars.
evals.expected_output: acme-march-timesheet data rendered to a PDF invoice: a saved definition that plans clean, reads only fields the timesheet holds, computes line amounts and the total as rounded formulas, and presents money in USD.
expectations: saves the definition as a .report.json file
the definition plans with no problems or warnings for pdf
renders the requested pdf file
computes totals with a sum aggregate
reads only fields the data holds
types no figure from the data into the definition
rounds money arithmetic with round(…, 2)
presents money as currency in USD

evals.name: statement-template-no-data
evals.prompt: we're about to start sending monthly account statements to customers. can you set up a quario template for it (PDF)? opening balance, that month's transactions, closing balance. we don't have the export from the billing system yet, I just want to see what it'd look like
evals.expected_output: A template: a definition plus a sample data file as its contract, a preview PDF rendered from the sample, the closing balance computed rather than stored.
expectations: saves the definition as a .report.json file
the definition plans with no problems or warnings for pdf
renders the requested pdf file
computes totals with a sum aggregate
reads only fields the sample holds
saves a sample data file as the template's contract
gives every sample field a value that shows
names the preview file as a preview
computes the closing balance instead of storing it in the sample

evals.name: grouped-xlsx-from-orders
evals.prompt: Make an Excel sales report from orders-q3.json, grouped by region with a subtotal per region and a grand total at the bottom. Finance wants to keep working with the numbers in Excel.
evals.expected_output: An xlsx workbook from a definition that groups by region with a subtotal aggregate and a report total, amounts kept as real numbers under a format kind.
expectations: saves the definition as a .report.json file
the definition plans with no problems or warnings for xlsx
renders the requested xlsx file
computes totals with a sum aggregate
reads only fields the data holds
types no figure from the data into the definition
groups by region with a subtotal aggregate
keeps the grand total a number in the workbook
presents amounts with a format kind, not a formatting function
